BS_ANCIENT_ANCIENT_NODE_ANCIENT.title: Node
BS_ANCIENT_ANCIENT_NODE_ANCIENT.pages.IN: The Queen of Winterbell awaits your choice.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_NODE_ANCIENT.title: Node
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_NODE_ANCIENT.talk.first: Welcome to the realm of dreams, honored visitor. I am its master.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_NODE_ANCIENT.talk.ANY.0: Time does not flow here. There is no need to hurry.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_NODE_ANCIENT.talk.IRONC: Are you cursed to fight forever? I hope you can escape that unjust fate.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_NODE_ANCIENT.talk.SILEN: That blight upon you... why do you continue to hunt?
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_NODE_ANCIENT.talk.DEFEC: Dear little life, I hope you can repair yourself.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_NODE_ANCIENT.talk.NECRO: Child trapped by revenge, I hope you find peace within.
Unless you're here to help me, get out of my way.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_NODE_ANCIENT.talk.REGEN: Visitor from the stars, you remind me of an old acquaintance. Hehe...
Where is that arrogant man? Where can I find him!
Please do not rush. Take my blessing.
BS_ANCIENT_ANCIENT_PRICKETT_ANCIENT.page: The Queen of Quinland awaits your choice.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_PRICKETT_ANCIENT.title: Prickett
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_PRICKETT_ANCIENT.talk.I: Death, slaughter, and blood. This place is a wonderful amusement park, so make it even livelier ☆
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_PRICKETT_ANCIENT.talk.S: Death, slaughter, and blood. This place is a wonderful amusement park, so make it even livelier ☆
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_PRICKETT_ANCIENT.talk.R: Traveler from the stars, welcome to Prickett's playground ☆
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_PRICKETT_ANCIENT.talk.N: You two over there, stop looking so gloomy. Come listen to Prickett's concert ☆
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_PRICKETT_ANCIENT.talk.D: Eh, how to fix you? A song should be enough ☆
